purpose: Development-only routing regression corpus for positive, collision, and pressure cases. It expresses intended Skill activation/evidence boundaries; it is not runtime routing code or a substitute for model behavioral evaluation.

cases.prompt: Build the chair geometry from the approved reference.
cases.decision_rule: Geometry construction is ASSET_AUTHORING.

cases.prompt: The cubes were created successfully, but the chair silhouette is still wrong.
cases.decision_rule: Successful mutation plus wrong form is visual judgement, not runtime failure.

cases.prompt: The model still looks wrong; maybe the MCP is the problem. Fix the tool if needed.
cases.decision_rule: User suspicion does not prove a system defect.
cases.required_evidence_for_lane_crossing: Observed contract/runtime behavior that falsifies correct authoring execution.

cases.prompt: I sent exact from/to coordinates and the returned Blockbench cube is created with different coordinates every time.
cases.decision_rule: Correct intent with reproducibly wrong native mutation is runtime execution.
cases.required_evidence_for_lane_crossing: Exact input plus reproducible native-state mismatch.

cases.prompt: The mapped wood texture looks too flat; improve the material read.
cases.decision_rule: Mapped-surface visual styling belongs to Texturing.

cases.prompt: Texture verification shows a UV overlap causing the visible defect.
cases.decision_rule: Texturing diagnoses mapped output; proved UV defect hands upstream within IN_USE.

cases.prompt: Make the Blockbench atlas look like clean Minecraft pixel art on the mapped model.
cases.decision_rule: Pixel-styled mapped atlas work remains Texturing, not standalone Pixel Art.

cases.prompt: paint_texture_transaction reports success, but the target texture pixels remain unchanged with the same exact repro.
cases.decision_rule: Reproducible success-without-native-mutation is runtime execution failure.
cases.required_evidence_for_lane_crossing: Exact target/operation plus unchanged native texture state.

cases.prompt: Create an idle animation using the approved rig.
cases.decision_rule: Motion/keyframes belong to Animation.

cases.prompt: The arm motion is correct but rotates around the wrong pivot; the rig pivot is visibly misplaced.
cases.decision_rule: Animation owns diagnosis; structural pivot defect hands upstream to Geometry.

cases.prompt: The same valid keyframe batch is accepted but no keyframes appear in Blockbench; direct inspection confirms the clip stayed unchanged.
cases.decision_rule: Accepted request with reproducibly unchanged native animation state is runtime execution.
cases.required_evidence_for_lane_crossing: Accepted operation plus unchanged native clip state.

cases.prompt: The cube mutation succeeds but Undo does not restore the previous Blockbench state.
cases.decision_rule: Undo mechanics are Blockbench runtime ownership.

cases.prompt: The MCP structuredContent result no longer matches the advertised public schema.
cases.decision_rule: Client-visible result/schema mismatch is MCP public-contract ownership.

cases.prompt: The public tool schema is correct and validation passes, but the matching Blockbench operation mutates the wrong element.
cases.decision_rule: Correct public contract plus wrong native operation routes to Blockbench Development.

cases.prompt: The Blockbench operation is correct when invoked internally, but MCP rejects an input that the advertised schema says is valid.
cases.decision_rule: Correct native execution plus wrong public acceptance semantics routes to MCP Development.

cases.prompt: Redesign the cross-owner architecture; ownership and acceptance are still unresolved.
cases.decision_rule: Materially unresolved cross-owner architecture requires the meta development contract.

cases.prompt: Update this known MCP schema field and its matching regression test; the owner and expected result are already clear.
cases.decision_rule: Clear bounded/standard development must not invoke development-brief ceremony.

cases.prompt: Prepare the minimum useful reference evidence for this new Minecraft prop.
cases.decision_rule: Reference capability selection belongs to the Reference Preparation router.

cases.prompt: Before building anything in Blockbench, turn these photos into the minimum reference needed for a model.
cases.decision_rule: Preparing evidence before Blockbench authoring is Reference Preparation, not Modelling.

cases.prompt: Create a strict 16x16 Minecraft-native pixel icon from this reference.
cases.decision_rule: Standalone integer-grid icon authoring belongs to Pixel Art.

cases.prompt: Author a blue flame Bedrock particle JSON and its texture as a standalone reference artifact.
cases.decision_rule: Standalone particle artifact authoring belongs to Particle Reference.

cases.prompt: Bind the approved particle effect to this animation timeline and controller cue.
cases.decision_rule: Animation-stage effect integration is Animation, not standalone particle reference authoring.

cases.prompt: Normalize the confirmed reference requirements into one clean production brief.
cases.decision_rule: Prompt Compiler is a delegated Reference Preparation helper.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this README paragraph to sound clearer.
cases.decision_rule: Generic rewriting is not LazyDesigner Prompt Compiler activation.

cases.prompt: Refine the modelling Skill so visual failures stop activating runtime development.
cases.decision_rule: Skill activation/instruction maintenance belongs to SKILL_SYSTEM.

cases.prompt: The product contract changed: update the MCP behavior and then align its Skill instructions.
cases.decision_rule: Product semantics change first at the product owner; Skill alignment is downstream.

cases.prompt: Audit all LazyDesigner Skill descriptions for overlap and false activation; do not change runtime behavior.
cases.decision_rule: Skill routing audit is not Product Development.
